services.name: Fishing Reports 2026
services.desc: Weekend update - We were headed offshore on another charter for tilefish and mahi at the canyons, but about 23 miles into our 3am departure the skipper ran into some diesel engine/turbo charger trouble. We had to turn around and limp home, but we will be back at it once the issue is rectified.Monday - I had return client Noel A, his son Matty, son Will (Travis) and Fin on a 5hr ocean fluke trip. Some of the anglers were first timers at ocean fluke, but they learned quick as we used some Minn Kota techniques to box 6 keepers to 6.5 pounds as well as a keeper sea bass.Our second trip of the day was a bay charter with new clients Heather, Heather, young Ryan and Sam on 3hr bay fluke charter.
